rules.description: List of raw iptables rule lines (e.g., `-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT`). Each line must be a valid iptables command fragment (without leading `iptables `). Comments (starting with `#`) and empty lines are allowed and preserved.

items.description: A single iptables rule line (e.g., `-A INPUT -s 192.168.1.0/24 -j ACCEPT`). Must be syntactically valid for `iptables-restore`. Use `-` for empty lines.
